zenBrowser_0.post_hook: sh -c 'CSS_CHROME="$HOME/.cache/noctalia/zen-browser/zen-userChrome.css"; CSS_CONTENT="$HOME/.cache/noctalia/zen-browser/zen-userContent.css"; LINE_CHROME="@import \"$CSS_CHROME\";"; LINE_CONTENT="@import \"$CSS_CONTENT\";"; find "$HOME/.config/zen" "$HOME/.zen" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d -name chrome -print0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d "" dir; do USER_CHROME="$dir/userChrome.css"; USER_CONTENT="$dir/userContent.css"; mkdir -p "$dir"; touch "$USER_CHROME" "$USER_CONTENT"; sed -i "/zen-browser\/zen-userChrome\.css/d" "$USER_CHROME"; sed -i "/zen-browser\/zen-userContent\.css/d" "$USER_CONTENT"; if ! grep -Fq "$LINE_CHROME" "$USER_CHROME"; then printf "%s\n" "$LINE_CHROME" >> "$USER_CHROME"; fi; if ! grep -Fq "$LINE_CONTENT" "$USER_CONTENT"; then printf "%s\n" "$LINE_CONTENT" >> "$USER_CONTENT"; fi; done'
